description: Crystal violet retention during decolourisation decays first-order at a rate set by the cell wall and by whether iodine has complexed the dye. Rates are chosen so that about 2–20 s of acetone–ethanol separates the classes; longer turns Gram-positive cells pink, shorter leaves Gram-negative cells purple, and no iodine turns everything pink.

provenance.notes: Teaching-scale rates tuned to the qualitative behaviour, not fitted to measurements.

description: Logistic growth with the organism's doubling time, scaled by a cardinal-temperature curve (zero below tMin and above tMax), only where a nutrient is present; antibiotics kill growing cells that lack the resistance marker. On agar, doubling is 1.5× slower and colonies are visible after about 17 doublings; their number is drawn (Poisson) from the viable cells.

Competent cells bind plasmid DNA on ice (time constant 5 min, saturating with DNA mass); a heat dose above 30 °C during the shock sets the uptake, which peaks at the dose of 50 s at 42 °C and falls for shorter or longer shocks; large doses kill. Lukewarm cells lose competence. Transformants express the plasmid's resistance over about 30 min at 37 °C (slower when cooler), and survive selection by half without it.

provenance.notes: Phenomenological, tuned so the standard protocol gives about 10³ transformants per µg.

description: Where contaminants come from in a teaching lab: airborne cells settling on what is uncovered (the bench's rate per cm² per hour), an unflamed rim letting one in on about 4 % of handlings (0.1 % flamed), and fingertips leaving their skin flora (about 150 colonies unwashed, 25 washed, 4 after an antiseptic wipe).

provenance.notes: Teaching-scale values: settle plates in occupied rooms give tens of colonies per 90 mm plate per hour; fingertip press plates give tens to hundreds, reduced by an order of magnitude by washing or alcohol. The rim probabilities are chosen so that careless handling contaminates a fair share of a series of broth transfers and careful handling almost none.
